Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3. While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Let’s make a French onion sourdough loaf 😍🧅🙌🏼 THE BEST FULL RECIPE: Ingredients: -   80g active starter -   350g purified water (room temp) -   500g bread flour -   5g salt + 5g beef bouillon  - 6-8oz of Gruyère shredded cheese  - 2 yellow onions sliced & carmelized with butter and salt  -   Add the starter and water to a large bowl and mix.  -   Add in the bread flour, salt, and bouillon seasoning then mix until the flour is incorporated and you have a shaggy dough ball -   Cover with a tea towel and rest on the counter for 1 hour.  -   After one hour, start your stretch and folds. This will be your first of four sets. You will stretch the dough then fold it over itself four times, spinning the bowl each time to grab a different section. Complete your first set of folds.  -   After 30 minutes, do your second set of stretch and folds. Cover the dough and rest for 30 minutes. -   After 30 minutes, stretch and fold and cover.  - After 30 more minutes, do your last and final set of stretch and folds. Cover again and let it rest for 6-10 hours or until it has doubled in size. -   Flour your surface (rice or bread flour), then flip the bowl over so the dough naturally falls out onto your surface. Try not to pop all of the bubbles but spread the dough out into a rectangle shape. Add your shredded cheese and onions.  Take the right side and fold it in then the left. Add last bit of cheese and onions. Then grab the bottom and roll the dough up. Then do push and pulls do form the dough into a ball. Flour your banneton basket. Then take your bench scraper (or your hands) and scoop up the dough and drop it into the banneton with the bottom of the ball facing up). Cover and put it in the fridge overnight to cold ferment. -   Preheat your oven to 450 degrees with the Dutch oven inside. -   Once the oven has preheated, take your dough out of the fridge. Place your hand on the dough and flip your it out of the basket and onto parchment paper or a bread mat with the smooth side facing up. -   You can dust it with more flour. Then score your loaf! -   Take your Dutch oven out and set in your loaf.  -   Bake with the lid on for 45 minutes. -   Take the lid off and drop the temp and bake for 5-10 more minutes. -   Let the loaf cool for 1 hour and ENJOY 🤭 #sourdough #frenchonionsoup #sourdoughbread #sourdoughtok #recipe

7 Viral Recipes That Took Over the Internet 🔥📱✨ Easy to make, big on flavor, and definitely worth trying! 😋 1️⃣ Baked Feta Pasta 🍅🧀🍝 Ingredients 🛒 • 2 cups cherry tomatoes 🍅 • 8 oz (225 g) feta cheese 🧀 • 3 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced 🧄 • 1 tsp dried oregano 🌿 • Salt & black pepper • 8 oz (225 g) pasta 🍝 • Fresh basil, for garnish 🌿 How to make 👨‍🍳 Add tomatoes, feta, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper to a baking dish. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 30 minutes. Cook the pasta separately, mash the baked feta and tomatoes together, then mix with pasta. Finish with fresh basil. 😍🔥 2️⃣ Cloud Bread ☁️🍞 Ingredients 🛒 • 3 large eggs, separated 🥚 • 3 tbsp cream cheese • ¼ tsp cream of tartar • ¼ tsp salt • 1 tbsp sweetener, optional How to make 👨‍🍳 Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Mix yolks with cream cheese, then gently fold in the whites. Spoon onto a lined baking sheet and bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25–30 minutes. ☁️✨ 3️⃣ Ranch Water 🍋‍🟩🧊 Ingredients 🍹 • 2 oz (60 ml) tequila • ½ oz (15 ml) fresh lime juice 🍋‍🟩 • Sparkling water • Ice 🧊 • Lime slice How to make 🍹 Fill a glass with ice, add tequila and lime juice, then top with sparkling water. Stir gently and garnish with lime. Refreshing and super simple! ✨ 4️⃣ Crooked Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪🍫 Ingredients 🛒 • 1 cup (227 g) butter 🧈 • 1 cup (220 g) brown sugar • ½ cup (100 g) sugar • 2 eggs 🥚 • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 2¾ cups (345 g) flour • 1 tsp baking soda • 1 tsp salt • 2 cups chocolate chips 🍫 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mix the wet ingredients, then add the dry ingredients. Fold in chocolate chips. Scoop into large uneven balls and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. Cool slightly before serving. 🤤 5️⃣ Viral Cucumber Salad 🥒🌶️ Ingredients 🛒 • Cucumbers, thinly sliced 🥒 • Soy sauce • Rice vinegar • Sesame oil • Chili crisp 🌶️ • Sesame seeds • Green onions How to make 👨‍🍳 Toss everything together and let sit for 15–20 minutes. Finish with sesame seeds and green onions. Crunchy, spicy, and addictive! 😍🔥 6️⃣ Banana Bread Baked Oats 🍌🥣 Ingredients 🛒 • 2 ripe bananas 🍌 • 2 eggs 🥚 • ½ cup (120 ml) milk • ¼ cup (60 ml) maple syrup 🍁 • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1½ cups (135 g) oats • 1 tsp baking powder • 1 tsp cinnamon • ¼ cup chocolate chips 🍫 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mash the bananas, mix in the remaining ingredients, and pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30–35 minutes. 🍌✨ 7️⃣ No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Cups 🍓🍰 Ingredients 🛒 • 1 cup (200 g) graham cracker crumbs • 4 tbsp melted butter 🧈 • 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese • ½ cup (120 ml) powdered sugar • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 cup (240 ml) whipped cream • 1 cup chopped strawberries 🍓 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mix graham crumbs with melted butter and press into cups. Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar and vanilla, then fold in whipped cream. Spoon over the crust, top with strawberries, and chill for at least 1 hour. 😍🍓 Which one would you try first? 🔥❤️ #ViralRecipes #EasyRecipes #FoodIdeas #TikTokRecipes #homecooking
